response.body:
Here are some tech-related events happening in Berlin this week:

```embeds_results_view
title: Tech Events in Berlin This Week
embeds: face-to-face-tpq, investing-in-civic-Ree, august-meetup-interactive-0pR, accelerate-data-transformation-Py8, business-networking-startups-DOX, idea-to-merge-3xB
```

- **[Professional Communication Exercise](embed:face-to-face-tpq)** — Sunday, August 2 at 1:00 PM. A practice session for architectural and elevator pitches held at Monbijou Park.
- **[Investing in Civic Infrastructure](embed:investing-in-civic-Ree)** — Tuesday, August 4 at 4:00 PM at Medulla. A public evening discussing permissioning, shared spaces, and the future of civic technology and digital infrastructure.
- **[August Meetup: Interactive Audio](embed:august-meetup-interactive-0pR)** — Tuesday, August 4 at 6:00 PM at Ableton AG. Features talks on interactive audio storytelling (Protagonists!) and detecting AI-generated content in hybrid music mixtures.
- **[Accelerate Data Transformation with Dataflows Gen2 in Microsoft Fabric](embed:accelerate-data-transformation-Py8)** — Tuesday, August 4 at 6:00 PM (Online). A deep-dive session hosted by the Microsoft Reactor team.
- **[Business Networking - Startups, Investors & Tech](embed:business-networking-startups-DOX)** — Tuesday, August 4 at 7:00 PM at Winterfeldtstraße 21. An evening designed to connect founders, investors, and tech professionals.
- **[Idea to Merge with the Copilot App](embed:idea-to-merge-3xB)** — Tuesday, August 4 at 10:00 PM (Online). An interactive session focused on using GitHub Copilot for issue-driven development and merging workflows.

Would you like help preparing for any of these events, or are you interested in a specific subfield like AI or software development?
